observed_failures: Unqualified in-corpus executive questions such as 'Who is Tesla CEO?' were incorrectly routed to disabled web search.
The router selected the calculator for common natural-language arithmetic, but the allow-listed parser rejected eight of ten labeled expressions.

behavior.filing_default: An ordinary question about a resolved in-corpus company uses filing RAG unless an explicit current, latest, live, news, market-data, online, or web-search cue is present.
behavior.web_boundary: Explicit current/external cues still route to web search and never fall back to filing evidence when search is unavailable.
behavior.calculator_boundary: Natural-language arithmetic is normalized into the existing bounded Decimal expression grammar; arbitrary code and unsupported operations remain rejected.

usage_and_cost.note: The gateway did not return price data. Deterministic routing removed provider calls from the new in-corpus and direct-calculation cases, reducing rather than increasing routed-model usage.
